actionAdapters.when: 读取真实Batch和注册Steps的脱敏参数Schema
已冻结具名Batch的创建、克隆、目标顺序与真实基础字段编辑时，只保存目标Settings
用户明确要求运行已保存Batch，实际Steps副作用与完整运行范围已获授权时；配置任务默认不运行

inputs.name: projectRoot
inputs.constraint: 从当前消费项目读取并冻结，不要求新手重复抄写可读取事实

inputs.name: pipifySettings
inputs.constraint: 读取Assets内现存真实Settings GUID、路径及窗口草稿；两个配置Action用settingsGuid，run-batch用pipifySettingsGuid

inputs.name: batchChangeSet
inputs.constraint: 明确create/clone/edit与目标名称；完整steps列表按编辑前sourceIndex保留复制排序，未列条目移除；edits仅真实基础字段和严格JSON token

inputs.name: runRequest
inputs.constraint: 默认只保存；运行另按真实Steps冻结副作用、平台、凭据、写集和产物证据，不因配置授权自动运行

allow: confirmed target PipifySettingsSO Batch name/description/ordered Steps and exact editable public parameter fields
explicitly requested saved Batch execution only within separately confirmed Step write sets
deny: Framework/package sources and handwritten Unity YAML
read-only, hidden or unsupported Array/List/object/property fields
arbitrary ParamsJson, Type.Method or C# execution
automatic pipeline execution, external write, deployment, Git or UPM publication from configuration authorization

requiredFor: Batch creation, cloning, renaming or saved changes
step removal or complete list replacement
explicitly requested Batch execution and its destructive/external/credential steps
confirmation.rule: 已有授权持续有效；展示具体Settings、目标Batch、完整Steps顺序、字段地址与风险，值尤其凭据不回显。确认绑定当前PlanId；输入、资产、Registry或构建环境漂移后重新Plan，重载只Verify不重放。

evidence: live Registry StepIds and exact parameter field Schema
confirmed target Settings GUID/path and full target Batch/Steps change set
configure-batch complete file/state verification and no-op preservation
credential redaction, untouched fields and draft protection
optional requested execution Job final state plus actual Step artifacts/evidence without treating saved configuration as runtime proof
temporary verification cleanup and retained formal Batch
